FUNCTION Z_ORVANTA_CFG_BC_READ
  IMPORTING
    VALUE(IV_BC_SET) TYPE STRING
    VALUE(IV_VERSION) TYPE STRING
  EXPORTING
    VALUE(EV_CODE) TYPE STRING
    VALUE(EV_SYSTEM) TYPE STRING
    VALUE(EV_CLIENT) TYPE STRING
    VALUE(EV_USER) TYPE STRING
    VALUE(EV_SOURCE_VERSION) TYPE STRING
    VALUE(EV_TARGET_VERSION) TYPE STRING
  TABLES
    ET_T006 LIKE T006
    ET_T006A LIKE T006A
    ET_T006B LIKE T006B
    ET_T006C LIKE T006C
    ET_T006D LIKE T006D.



DATA: ls_header TYPE scprattr,
      ls_record TYPE scprreca,
      lt_records TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scprreca,
      lt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scprvals,
      lt_languages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scprvall,
      lt_dependencies TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scprpprl,
      lt_t006 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006,
      lt_t006a TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006a,
      lt_t006b TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006b,
      lt_t006c TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006c,
      lt_t006d TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006d,
      lv_table TYPE tddat-tabname,
      lv_group TYPE tddat-cclass,
      lv_source TYPE xstring,
      lv_target TYPE xstring,
      lv_source_first TYPE xstring,
      lv_target_first TYPE xstring,
      lv_source_hash TYPE string,
      lv_target_hash TYPE string,
      lv_count TYPE i.
" 每次初始化全部输出；失败不泄露前次调用的行或版本。
CLEAR: ev_code, ev_system, ev_client, ev_user,
       ev_source_version, ev_target_version.
REFRESH et_t006.
REFRESH et_t006a.
REFRESH et_t006b.
REFRESH et_t006c.
REFRESH et_t006d.
ev_system = sy-sysid.
ev_client = sy-mandt.
ev_user = sy-uname.
IF sy-sysid <> 'GR2' OR sy-mandt <> '200'.
  ev_code = 'SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
IF iv_bc_set <> 'EHS_CUNI_KNM' OR iv_version <> 'N'.
  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
" 逐表验证读取权限；没有授权组时沿用 &NC&，名称权限可替代组权限。
DO 10 TIMES.
  CASE sy-index.
    WHEN 1. lv_table = 'T006'.
    WHEN 2. lv_table = 'T006A'.
    WHEN 3. lv_table = 'T006B'.
    WHEN 4. lv_table = 'T006C'.
    WHEN 5. lv_table = 'T006D'.
    WHEN 6. lv_table = 'SCPRATTR'.
    WHEN 7. lv_table = 'SCPRRECA'.
    WHEN 8. lv_table = 'SCPRVALS'.
    WHEN 9. lv_table = 'SCPRVALL'.
    WHEN 10. lv_table = 'SCPRPPRL'.
  ENDCASE.
  CLEAR lv_group.
  SELECT SINGLE cclass INTO lv_group FROM tddat
    WHERE tabname = lv_table.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_group IS INITIAL.
    lv_group = '&NC&'.
  ENDIF.
  AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_DIS'
    ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '03' ID 'DICBERCLS' FIELD lv_group.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_NAM'
      ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '03' ID 'TABLE' FIELD lv_table.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      ev_code = 'AUTHORIZATION_DENIED'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
ENDDO.
" 两轮完整读取并比较原生缓冲；这是顺序观察，不是加锁快照。
DO 2 TIMES.
  SELECT SINGLE * INTO ls_header FROM scprattr
    WHERE id = 'EHS_CUNI_KNM' AND version = 'N'.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    ev_code = 'SOURCE_NOT_FOUND'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  IF ls_header-category IS NOT INITIAL OR ls_header-type <> 'TMV'.
    ev_code = 'SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  SELECT * FROM scprreca INTO TABLE lt_records UP TO 6 ROWS
    WHERE id = 'EHS_CUNI_KNM' AND version = 'N'.
  DESCRIBE TABLE lt_records LINES lv_count.
  IF lv_count <> 5.
    ev_code = 'SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  SORT lt_records BY id version tablename recnumber.
  LOOP AT lt_records INTO ls_record.
    CASE sy-tabix.
      WHEN 1. lv_table = 'T006'.
      WHEN 2. lv_table = 'T006A'.
      WHEN 3. lv_table = 'T006B'.
      WHEN 4. lv_table = 'T006C'.
      WHEN 5. lv_table = 'T006D'.
    ENDCASE.
    IF ls_record-tablename <> lv_table OR ls_record-recnumber <> 1
    OR ls_record-objectname <> 'CUNI' OR ls_record-objecttype <> 'T'
    OR ls_record-deleteflag IS NOT INITIAL
    OR ls_record-uncomplete IS NOT INITIAL
    OR ls_record-genref IS NOT INITIAL
    OR ls_record-activity IS NOT INITIAL
    OR ls_record-clustname IS NOT INITIAL.
      ev_code = 'SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  SELECT * FROM scprvals INTO TABLE lt_values UP TO 101 ROWS
    WHERE id = 'EHS_CUNI_KNM' AND version = 'N'.
  DESCRIBE TABLE lt_values LINES lv_count.
  IF lv_count > 100.
    ev_code = 'SOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  SORT lt_values BY id version tablename recnumber fieldname.
  SELECT * FROM scprvall INTO TABLE lt_languages UP TO 101 ROWS
    WHERE id = 'EHS_CUNI_KNM' AND version = 'N'.
  DESCRIBE TABLE lt_languages LINES lv_count.
  IF lv_count > 100.
    ev_code = 'SOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  SORT lt_languages BY id version tablename recnumber fieldname langu.
  SELECT * FROM scprpprl INTO TABLE lt_dependencies UP TO 1 ROWS
    WHERE id = 'EHS_CUNI_KNM' AND version = 'N'.
  IF lt_dependencies IS NOT INITIAL.
    ev_code = 'SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  SELECT * FROM t006 INTO TABLE lt_t006 WHERE msehi = 'KNM'.
  SELECT * FROM t006a INTO TABLE lt_t006a WHERE msehi = 'KNM'
    AND ( spras = '1' OR spras = 'D' OR spras = 'E' ).
  " 别名按自身键读取；映射到其他单位的冲突也必须返回。
  SELECT * FROM t006b INTO TABLE lt_t006b WHERE mseh3 = 'KNM'
    AND ( spras = '1' OR spras = 'D' OR spras = 'E' ).
  SELECT * FROM t006c INTO TABLE lt_t006c WHERE mseh6 = 'kN/m2'
    AND ( spras = '1' OR spras = 'D' OR spras = 'E' ).
  " PRESS 是共享维度；这里只读取完整行，不做保存。
  SELECT * FROM t006d INTO TABLE lt_t006d WHERE dimid = 'PRESS'.
  SORT lt_t006 BY mandt msehi.
  SORT lt_t006a BY mandt spras msehi.
  SORT lt_t006b BY mandt spras mseh3.
  SORT lt_t006c BY mandt spras mseh6.
  SORT lt_t006d BY mandt dimid.
  " 原生类型序列化包括 FLTP、空格和缺失行；不经显示文本重建。
  EXPORT namespace = 'ORVANTA_BC_SOURCE_V1'
    system = sy-sysid client = sy-mandt
    header = ls_header records = lt_records values = lt_values
    languages = lt_languages dependencies = lt_dependencies
    TO DATA BUFFER lv_source.
  EXPORT namespace = 'ORVANTA_BC_TARGET_V1'
    system = sy-sysid client = sy-mandt user = sy-uname
    bc_set = iv_bc_set version = iv_version
    unit = lt_t006 texts = lt_t006a commercial = lt_t006b
    technical = lt_t006c dimension = lt_t006d
    TO DATA BUFFER lv_target.
  IF sy-index = 1.
    lv_source_first = lv_source.
    lv_target_first = lv_target.
  ELSEIF lv_source <> lv_source_first OR lv_target <> lv_target_first.
    ev_code = 'READ_CHANGED'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
ENDDO.
CALL FUNCTION 'CALCULATE_HASH_FOR_RAW'
  EXPORTING alg = 'SHA2' data = lv_source
  IMPORTING hashstring = lv_source_hash
  EXCEPTIONS unknown_alg = 1 param_error = 2 internal_error = 3
             error_message = 4 OTHERS = 5.
IF sy-subrc <> 0.
  ev_code = 'HASH_FAILED'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
CALL FUNCTION 'CALCULATE_HASH_FOR_RAW'
  EXPORTING alg = 'SHA2' data = lv_target
  IMPORTING hashstring = lv_target_hash
  EXCEPTIONS unknown_alg = 1 param_error = 2 internal_error = 3
             error_message = 4 OTHERS = 5.
IF sy-subrc <> 0.
  ev_code = 'HASH_FAILED'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
TRANSLATE lv_source_hash TO LOWER CASE.
TRANSLATE lv_target_hash TO LOWER CASE.
IF strlen( lv_source_hash ) <> 64 OR strlen( lv_target_hash ) <> 64
OR lv_source_hash CN '0123456789abcdef'
OR lv_target_hash CN '0123456789abcdef'.
  ev_code = 'HASH_FAILED'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
et_t006[] = lt_t006[].
et_t006a[] = lt_t006a[].
et_t006b[] = lt_t006b[].
et_t006c[] = lt_t006c[].
et_t006d[] = lt_t006d[].
ev_source_version = lv_source_hash.
ev_target_version = lv_target_hash.
ev_code = 'READ_OK'.





ENDFUNCTION.
```

    WHEN 1. lv_table = 'T006'.
    WHEN 2. lv_table = 'T006A'.
    WHEN 3. lv_table = 'T006B'.
    WHEN 4. lv_table = 'T006C'.
    WHEN 5. lv_table = 'T006D'.
    WHEN 6. lv_table = 'SCPRATTR'.
    WHEN 7. lv_table = 'SCPRRECA'.
    WHEN 8. lv_table = 'SCPRVALS'.
    WHEN 9. lv_table = 'SCPRVALL'.
    WHEN 10. lv_table = 'SCPRPPRL'.
  ENDCASE.
  CLEAR lv_group.
  SELECT SINGLE cclass INTO lv_group FROM tddat
    WHERE tabname = lv_table.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_group IS INITIAL.
    lv_group = '&NC&'.
  ENDIF.
  AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_DIS'
    ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '03' ID 'DICBERCLS' FIELD lv_group.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_NAM'
      ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '03' ID 'TABLE' FIELD lv_table.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      ev_code = 'AUTHORIZATION_DENIED'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
ENDDO.
" 两轮完整读取并比较原生缓冲；这是顺序观察，不是加锁快照。
DO 2 TIMES.
  SELECT SINGLE * INTO ls_header FROM scprattr
    WHERE id = 'EHS_CUNI_KNM' AND version = 'N'.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    ev_code = 'SOURCE_NOT_FOUND'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  IF ls_header-category IS NOT INITIAL OR ls_header-type <> 'TMV'.
    ev_code = 'SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  SELECT * FROM scprreca INTO TABLE lt_records UP TO 6 ROWS
    WHERE id = 'EHS_CUNI_KNM' AND version = 'N'.
  DESCRIBE TABLE lt_records LINES lv_count.
  IF lv_count <> 5.
    ev_code = 'SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  SORT lt_records BY id version tablename recnumber.
  LOOP AT lt_records INTO ls_record.
    CASE sy-tabix.
      WHEN 1. lv_table = 'T006'.
      WHEN 2. lv_table = 'T006A'.
      WHEN 3. lv_table = 'T006B'.
      WHEN 4. lv_table = 'T006C'.
      WHEN 5. lv_table = 'T006D'.
    ENDCASE.
    IF ls_record-tablename <> lv_table OR ls_record-recnumber <> 1
    OR ls_record-objectname <> 'CUNI' OR ls_record-objecttype <> 'T'
    OR ls_record-deleteflag IS NOT INITIAL
    OR ls_record-uncomplete IS NOT INITIAL
    OR ls_record-genref IS NOT INITIAL
    OR ls_record-activity IS NOT INITIAL
    OR ls_record-clustname IS NOT INITIAL.
      ev_code = 'SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  SELECT * FROM scprvals INTO TABLE lt_values UP TO 101 ROWS
    WHERE id = 'EHS_CUNI_KNM' AND version = 'N'.
  DESCRIBE TABLE lt_values LINES lv_count.
  IF lv_count > 100.
    ev_code = 'SOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  SORT lt_values BY id version tablename recnumber fieldname.
  SELECT * FROM scprvall INTO TABLE lt_languages UP TO 101 ROWS
    WHERE id = 'EHS_CUNI_KNM' AND version = 'N'.
  DESCRIBE TABLE lt_languages LINES lv_count.
  IF lv_count > 100.
    ev_code = 'SOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  SORT lt_languages BY id version tablename recnumber fieldname langu.
  SELECT * FROM scprpprl INTO TABLE lt_dependencies UP TO 1 ROWS
    WHERE id = 'EHS_CUNI_KNM' AND version = 'N'.
  IF lt_dependencies IS NOT INITIAL.
    ev_code = 'SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  SELECT * FROM t006 INTO TABLE lt_t006 WHERE msehi = 'KNM'.
  SELECT * FROM t006a INTO TABLE lt_t006a WHERE msehi = 'KNM'
    AND ( spras = '1' OR spras = 'D' OR spras = 'E' ).
  " 别名按自身键读取；映射到其他单位的冲突也必须返回。
  SELECT * FROM t006b INTO TABLE lt_t006b WHERE mseh3 = 'KNM'
    AND ( spras = '1' OR spras = 'D' OR spras = 'E' ).
  SELECT * FROM t006c INTO TABLE lt_t006c WHERE mseh6 = 'kN/m2'
    AND ( spras = '1' OR spras = 'D' OR spras = 'E' ).
  " PRESS 是共享维度；这里只读取完整行，不做保存。
  SELECT * FROM t006d INTO TABLE lt_t006d WHERE dimid = 'PRESS'.
  SORT lt_t006 BY mandt msehi.
  SORT lt_t006a BY mandt spras msehi.
  SORT lt_t006b BY mandt spras mseh3.
  SORT lt_t006c BY mandt spras mseh6.
  SORT lt_t006d BY mandt dimid.
  " 原生类型序列化包括 FLTP、空格和缺失行；不经显示文本重建。
  EXPORT namespace = 'ORVANTA_BC_SOURCE_V1'
    system = sy-sysid client = sy-mandt
    header = ls_header records = lt_records values = lt_values
    languages = lt_languages dependencies = lt_dependencies
    TO DATA BUFFER lv_source.
  EXPORT namespace = 'ORVANTA_BC_TARGET_V1'
    system = sy-sysid client = sy-mandt user = sy-uname
    bc_set = iv_bc_set version = iv_version
    unit = lt_t006 texts = lt_t006a commercial = lt_t006b
    technical = lt_t006c dimension = lt_t006d
    TO DATA BUFFER lv_target.
  IF sy-index = 1.
    lv_source_first = lv_source.
    lv_target_first = lv_target.
  ELSEIF lv_source <> lv_source_first OR lv_target <> lv_target_first.
    ev_code = 'READ_CHANGED'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
ENDDO.
CALL FUNCTION 'CALCULATE_HASH_FOR_RAW'
  EXPORTING alg = 'SHA2' data = lv_source
  IMPORTING hashstring = lv_source_hash
  EXCEPTIONS unknown_alg = 1 param_error = 2 internal_error = 3
             error_message = 4 OTHERS = 5.
IF sy-subrc <> 0.
  ev_code = 'HASH_FAILED'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
CALL FUNCTION 'CALCULATE_HASH_FOR_RAW'
  EXPORTING alg = 'SHA2' data = lv_target
  IMPORTING hashstring = lv_target_hash
  EXCEPTIONS unknown_alg = 1 param_error = 2 internal_error = 3
             error_message = 4 OTHERS = 5.
IF sy-subrc <> 0.
  ev_code = 'HASH_FAILED'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
TRANSLATE lv_source_hash TO LOWER CASE.
TRANSLATE lv_target_hash TO LOWER CASE.
IF strlen( lv_source_hash ) <> 64 OR strlen( lv_target_hash ) <> 64
OR lv_source_hash CN '0123456789abcdef'
OR lv_target_hash CN '0123456789abcdef'.
  ev_code = 'HASH_FAILED'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
et_t006[] = lt_t006[].
et_t006a[] = lt_t006a[].
et_t006b[] = lt_t006b[].
et_t006c[] = lt_t006c[].
et_t006d[] = lt_t006d[].
ev_source_version = lv_source_hash.
ev_target_version = lv_target_hash.
ev_code = 'READ_OK'.





ENDFUNCTION.
